table:columns.name: TOLEMI_ID
table:columns.description: Property identifier assigned by Tolemi (the BuildingBlocks data platform SLDC uses to assemble its vacancy composite; the source layer is SLDC.SLDC.Tol_Def_Vac_NP).

table:columns.name: PID1
table:columns.description: First parcel identifier for the property as carried in the Tolemi composite (exact scheme not documented; PID2 is a second identifier).

table:columns.name: STREET_ADD
table:columns.description: Street address of the property (shapefile-truncated name).

table:columns.name: PROPERTY_T
table:columns.description: Property type (shapefile-truncated 'PROPERTY_TYPE'; no decode published).

table:columns.name: TOLEMI_DEF
table:columns.description: Tolemi 'definite vacancy' determination for the property — the flag/category under which the parcel qualified for this definite-vacant composite (layer name Tol_Def_Vac; no public decode found).

table:columns.name: LRA_OWNED_
table:columns.description: Whether the property is owned by the Land Reutilization Authority (shapefile-truncated flag).

table:columns.name: LRA_RORE
table:columns.description: LRA inventory attribute (untruncated meaning not documented; no public decode found).

table:columns.name: VACANT_BUI
table:columns.description: Vacant-building indicator (shapefile-truncated 'VACANT_BUILDING', i.e. on the city vacant building registry).

table:columns.name: CONDEMNATI
table:columns.description: Condemnation indicator for the structure (shapefile-truncated 'CONDEMNATION').

table:columns.name: NSR_OWNED_
table:columns.description: Flag for ownership recorded in the city's vacancy pipeline under 'NSR' (not expanded in any public documentation found).

table:columns.name: PRIVATE_VA
table:columns.description: Privately-owned vacant indicator (shapefile-truncated 'PRIVATE_VACANT').

table:columns.name: LAND_SIZE
table:columns.description: Land area of the parcel (units not documented in the source; city parcel land areas are square feet).

table:columns.name: STRUCTUREA
table:columns.description: Structure area (shapefile-truncated; likely 'STRUCTURE_AREA').

table:columns.name: YEAR_BUILT
table:columns.description: Year the structure was built.

table:columns.name: OWNER_NAME
table:columns.description: Owner name of record; OWNER_ADDR is the owner's mailing address.

table:columns.name: OWNER_TENU
table:columns.description: Owner tenure (shapefile-truncated 'OWNER_TENURE'; no decode published).

table:columns.name: TAX_DELINQ
table:columns.description: Tax delinquency indicator for the property.

table:columns.name: LRA_STATUS
table:columns.description: Status of the property within the LRA inventory; LRA_DATE is the associated date.

table:columns.name: BISA_SCORE
table:columns.description: Building Inspection/condition score carried in the composite ('BISA' not expanded in public documentation).

table:columns.name: HANDLE
table:columns.description: Citywide parcel handle (join key to parcels); COLPARCELI is the truncated Collector parcel ID.

table:columns.name: NBRHD
table:columns.description: City neighborhood number (city 'Neighborhood' vocabulary).

table:columns.name: ZONING
table:columns.description: Zoning district code (city 'Zoning Code' vocabulary).

table:columns.name: CENSBLOCK2
table:columns.description: 2020 census block (shapefile-truncated 'CENSBLOCK20').

table:columns.name: WARD20
table:columns.description: 2020-cycle aldermanic ward number.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
